title: Give each artifact one producing wagon; consumers reference its contract

facts.note: Wagon manifests are identifiable by path/file kind.
Planning task text mentions artifact ownership or wagon interfaces.

values: contract field added/removed on an interface entry
facts.note: Requires a diff-level observer over wagon manifest produce[]/consume[] entries.

values: artifact declared in produce[] by more than one wagon
artifact consumed with no producing wagon (orphan)
consumer entry contract path differs from producer contract path (when both present)
facts.note: Cross-wagon ownership/coverage check; implementation.type is none in source, so no detector exists yet.

fires: Planner adds a wagon that outputs an artifact and declares it in produce[]
Planner adds a consume[] entry to a wagon for an artifact produced by another wagon
Planner authors a new wagon interface and decides whether to include contract fields
doesNotFire: Edits to wagon fields unrelated to produce[]/consume[] (e.g. description, WMBT wording)
Implementation code changes inside a wagon that do not touch its interface declaration
Contract schema content edits that do not change which wagon produces or consumes the artifact

given: A plan declares wagon interfaces with produce[] and consume[] artifact entries
when: The planner adds or changes a produce[] or consume[] entry for an artifact
then: Declare the artifact in produce[] of exactly one wagon, which generates (owns) its contract; every other wagon using it declares it in consume[] and references that existing contract instead of generating its own.
prefer: Producer entry: artifact name, destination, and (optionally) the path of the contract it generates
Consumer entry: same artifact name, `from` the producing wagon, and (if given) the producer's contract path
Contract field is optional on every entry but recommended; new wagons should add explicit contract references
avoid: Two wagons declaring the same artifact in produce[] (split ownership)
A consumer generating or redefining its own contract for an artifact another wagon produces
Consuming an artifact no wagon produces (orphan)
unless: Any entry may omit the contract field (required=false, backward compatibility); existing wagons work with implicit contracts
why: Single producer ownership with consumers referencing the same contract makes bidirectional producer/consumer coverage and orphan detection possible.
evidence: For every artifact exactly one wagon lists it in produce[]; where that producer entry has a contract field, it points to the generated contract (implicit contracts without the field remain valid)
Every consume[] entry names a producing wagon in `from`; where both consumer and producer carry a contract path, they are equal
Recommendation check only (not a violation): whether newly added wagons carry explicit contract fields; absence is reported as a recommendation gap
verifier_detail: Role definitions: producer = generates artifact contract (wagon that declares artifact in produce[]); consumer = references existing contract (wagon that declares artifact in consume[]).
Contract field values: required=false, recommended=true; rationale: optional for backward compatibility, recommended for the artifact-centric contract system.
Absence of the contract field on any entry is never a violation (implicit contracts); on new wagons it is at most a recommendation gap.
Source positive example (producer): wagon resolve-dilemmas: produce name mechanic:decision.choice, to external, contract contracts/artifacts/decision/choice.json
Source positive example (consumer): wagon commit-state: consume name mechanic:decision.choice, from wagon:resolve-dilemmas, contract contracts/artifacts/decision/choice.json
